verdict.rationale: Sumsub is an identity-verification SaaS with AI features (Summy AI, liveness, anomaly detection), so asking whether customer data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a data-use policy for model training, or any related control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
